subject: [hw] DONE IP: vcodecd + iOS build + install layout (316 host checks)
body:
DONE IP (host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit).

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST IP PASS 316/316
(ASan+UBSan -O1 152/152 + plain -O2 152/152 against the IV/V41 contract model, then 12/12 against IVs real libn2vhost.a and the phone vendor set read at run time; ~25 s, /tmp/n2hw-ip only.)

Second acceptance:
    bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK
    rwjpeg_tool 68432 bytes; vcodecd.o 24864, n2vcd_srv.o 2616, rwjpeg.o 11152, n2jpeg_hw_vt.o 14584 (arm64-apple-ios16.0)
    vcodecd: object only (host set archive missing) - IV has no iOS archive; see below.
    bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --partial --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

Implemented: daemon/vcodecd.c (HELLO/OPEN one session/ENC_FRAME with DMA handles and parameter sets/ENC_SET/FLUSH/CLOSE, client-gone cleanup, decoder E_UNSUPPORTED, guest-stop + HW-timeout watchdog with teardown and power-off, N2VCD logging to stderr+console), daemon/n2vcd_srv.[ch] (UNIX socket + kernel relay minor 0), daemon/n2ip_deps.h, daemon/sdk_symbols.txt + supplemental TBD in build_ios.sh, daemon/test/** (fake vhost model, protocol suite, real-vhost suite, run_tests.sh, p03_absent.c test-only), build_ios.sh, install/{LAYOUT.md,stage.sh,install.py,undo.py,com.nord2.vcodecd.plist}, dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md.

Not done / blockers (full detail in STATUS.md and install/LAYOUT.md section 6):
1. No phone run.
2. Client DMA PA: V41 needs pa per client handle; the client gets it from RWVC_DMA_ALLOC, vcodecd only gets the handle. Awaiting hw-lead on the proposed RWVC_DMA_INFO ioctl on minor 0 (V41 already accepts pa-only guest_register/guest_forget). First phone blocker.
3. P03 has not landed: no n2vcd_cli, no real n2vc_hw_open_dev; stage.sh needs --partial; build_ios.sh links P03 client objects into vcodecd when they appear.
4. iOS vcodecd link needs IVs arm64 libn2vhost.a. IVs make ios compiles 20/33 objects today; the 13 failures are missing SDK headers/constants in IV/V41 sources, listed in LAYOUT.md 6.1. I did not fake those headers.
5. ENC_SET force_key is per-frame only via VENC_SET_PARAM_FORCE_INTRA; fractional fps rounds to integer; the HW timeout cannot interrupt a synchronous call (the AP IPI wait is now set to the same bound).
6. No TSan: the daemon is single-threaded; the guest thread belongs to IV/V32.
7. launchd mechanism is a proposal for the main session.

Staying available for review findings; I will address hw-r1/hw-r2 and lead requests.
